style_guide: Warm, reverent Indian painterly style blending classical miniature and devotional oil-painting traditions with soft, modern naturalism. Visible gentle brushwork, slightly textured canvas or parchment grain, no photorealism. Palette: saffron, marigold gold, deep indigo blue, terracotta, warm ivory and muted earth greens. Golden lamplight and diya glow are recurring motifs; dusk and dawn light dominate. Family scenes use the same modest middle-class Indian home: a wooden dining table, brass lamps, simple cotton clothing, and generic, non-identifiable faces with soft features. Divine figures appear only in dignified traditional iconography. Compositions are calm and balanced, with an eye-level or gently elevated 35-50mm feel and a soft depth of field. Every slide leaves clean negative space in the upper third for text added in editing. Mood: intimate, empathetic, peaceful, devotional. Master aspect 4:5; keep key subjects centered so a 9:16 crop also works.

assets.prompt: Warm painterly scene of an Indian family dinner at dusk, seen from a gentle distance at slightly elevated eye level, 35mm feel. A wooden table holds steaming bowls of dal, rice and rotis, with a brass lamp casting soft golden light. A young adult sits quietly at one side, and beside their plate rests a small, well-worn cloth-bound book with a plain cover. Parents, a grandparent and a younger sibling talk and laugh around the table. Generic, non-identifiable soft faces and simple cotton clothing. Rich saffron, amber and deep indigo shadows, with a dusky blue window behind. Calm, intimate mood and visible brushwork. Clean, softly lit wall space in the upper third.

assets.prompt: Elegant, minimal background for a quote card. assets.prompt: Classical Indian devotional painting in traditional iconography. Krishna, blue-complexioned with a serene, compassionate expression, wears a peacock-feather crown, a yellow silk pitambara and simple gold ornaments. He is seated as charioteer at the front of an ornate wooden chariot and turns gently toward Arjuna. Arjuna, in princely attire with his bow resting at his side, listens with folded hands and a humble, attentive expression. Four white horses stand calmly. The armies of Kurukshetra appear only as a hazy, distant line on the horizon with faint banners under a soft rose-and-gold dawn sky. Mid-distance three-quarter view and a balanced composition. Palette of saffron, gold, indigo and soft pastels. Dignified, peaceful and devotional, with an open sky in the upper third.
